# Nell Harcourt

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old  <sub>[v2 c9 P36](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0036), [v2 c16 P20](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0020), [v2 c23 P7](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0007)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v2 c2 P0](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0000), [v2 c16 P20](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c4 P40](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0040), [v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c11 P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 c26 P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024), [v2 c28 P24](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Nell has a small, slender frame and a white face with a small pointed chin, a pleasant nose, and seven freckles. She has large, starry grey eyes and thick, long red hair often described as auburn or Titian. Over the years, her scrawny appearance softened into a taller, straight-backed, and ethereal figure.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P1](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0001), [v1 c8 P55](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0055), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 c33 P43](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0043), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032), [v2 c9 P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), [v2 c16 P26](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0026), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P41](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0041)_

## Personality

Nell is an imaginative, passionate, and unselfish person with a vivid internal life. She possesses a fast temper and can harbor animosity, yet she is deeply affectionate and devoted to her friends and family. Although prone to worrying about her appearance and past blunders, she displays strong resolve when challenged.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c7 P2](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0002), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c33 P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v2 c10 P4](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0004), [v2 c26 P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024)_

## History

Nell Harcourt was born in Harborough, Nova Scotia, to high school teachers Edmund and Bertha Harcourt, both of whom died of fever shortly after her birth. She was taken in by Mrs. Thomas until age eight, then moved upriver to care for Mrs. Rudge's children, and eventually ended up in an asylum at Marden for four months. She was brought from the asylum to Brierley to reside at Grey Shutters with Thirza Abernethy and Obed Abernethy, who became her guardians and loved her like their own child. Nell attended the local school, engaging in a intense academic rivalry with Hugh Carrow. She later pursued Second Year work at Regent's Academy, earning high honors and winning the Avery scholarship. Following the sudden death of Obed, Nell remained at Grey Shutters to support Thirza, took up a job as a local schoolteacher, and served as secretary for the newly founded Brierley Village Improvement Society. Later, she prepared to leave Brierley to attend Wexcombe College alongside Hugh.

> Oh, Mrs. Sowerby, my regret is so immense,” she uttered while her voice trembled slightly. “Even exhaustively reciting every word in a dictionary would fail to convey the full extent of my remorse.
